About the author

John W Partington is a Canadian writer living in Ottawa, Ontario. He was a soldier for fifteen years in the Canadian Forces. After completing one tour of duty he suffered a bout of mental illness which resulted in a medical discharge from the Canadian Forces. Since then he has had a few jobs. Writing, however, will always be his first love (his wife is his true love).
